scenes.headline: How an agent edited a small model's weights
scenes.sub: One direction, two matrices, no gradients
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Solder! An agent was handed a small model's weights and asked to make it better at math, with no training. Here is what it changed.

scenes.text: The model loops while it thinks. Find the direction its MLPs write when it loops, and remove that write from a few neurons.
scenes.say: The small model loops while it thinks. So find the direction its MLPs write when it is looping, and take that write out of a few neurons.

scenes.title: From a looping answer to an edit

steps.say: First it read the failures. Eighty-five of ninety-six practice answers ran to the token limit.
It compared the model's activations on looping and on productive text, and took the difference as one direction.
Then it subtracted that direction from the MLP output matrices of layers fifteen and nineteen.
Every candidate was run against the original on the same problems, and the dose was raised step by step.

scenes.title: The whole edit
scenes.text: W' = W - 6 u (u . W) on 64 columns

parts.note: each column's part along the loop direction
parts.say: This term is how much each column writes along the loop direction.

parts.note: six times it: the part flips to minus five
parts.say: Subtracting six times that part does not just remove it. It flips it to minus five times what it was.

parts.note: 64 neurons per layer, in two layers
parts.say: Only sixty-four neurons per layer are touched, in two layers. That is the whole change.

scenes.label: Published MATH-500 answers that closed their thinking

scenes.title: What the edit is and is not

left.title: It is
items: A loop fix in thinking mode
Rank one, found with forward passes
left.say: It is a loop fix in thinking mode, rank one, found with forward passes and paired tests.

right.title: It is not
right.say: It does not add math the model could not already do, and on Gemma, which rarely loops, the same approach found nothing.

scenes.text: An agent can find and fix one failure mode in weights. Check what the base scores without that failure first.
scenes.say: An agent can find and fix one failure mode directly in the weights. Before you credit the gain, check what the base model scores without that failure.
Two matrices, one direction each. The loops go down and the answers finish. And always compare with thinking off.
